newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable, South Korea higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable, South Korea higher.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes on Wednesday were steady from Tuesday amid healthy demand, traders said.
They said higher South Korean prices have caused most shipowners to buy bunker fuel in Singapore.

Majors were asking $121 per tonne for 180-cst and at $115-$116 for 380-cst. Independents were lower at $114-$115 for 380-cst and $120 for 180-cst. Prices in South Korea were higher at $122-$124 for 180-cst and at $126-128 for 380-cst.
MDO and gas oil prices were also lower at $207-$215 and $220-$225 respectively on weaker crude prices, traders said.
